science.protocol: science-v2.2: expanding-origin; 400 training-year bootstrap draws; pre-test Aqua-only historical reference; conservative rank fractions; threshold-disagreement review; 1km/5,15,30min point associations

bootstrap.note: 5th–95th percentiles of training-year refits. Sensitivity bands, not confidence or prediction intervals. Clouds, missed fires and other sensor errors are excluded.
